question_text: Observation has primary key (DeviceID, TechnicianID, RecordedAt). A device may be checked repeatedly by the same technician. Outline why RecordedAt is part of the key.
adaptation_rationale: Composite key uniqueness explicitly scoped. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: The DeviceID/TechnicianID pair repeats for later checks; adding the timestamp distinguishes separate observations, assuming at most one observation for that pair at each timestamp.

marking_points.criterion: Timestamp distinguishes separate observations under the stated uniqueness rule.
